commands.typecheck: xcodegen generate && git diff --exit-code Mather.xcodeproj && xcodebuild -project Mather.xcodeproj -resolvePackageDependencies -scheme Mather && xcodebuild build-for-testing -project Mather.xcodeproj -scheme Mather -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
commands.test: xcodegen generate && git diff --exit-code Mather.xcodeproj && xcodebuild test -project Mather.xcodeproj -scheme Mather -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16,OS=latest" -only-testing MatherTests CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
